name: Sudan
value: RSF drone kills 9 in Blue Nile; Kordofan battles
summary: RSF drone strike kills nine civilians in Blue Nile; army advances in West Kordofan; famine risk spreads
state: Officials in Blue Nile state said an RSF drone strike killed nine civilians in a village near Kurmuk, reported on 10 Nov (Sudan Tribune). The army said it shot down its fourth drone in a week in West Kordofan and seized villages near Al-Khuwei on 7–8 Nov (Anadolu, 9 Nov). FEWS NET says the risk of Famine has spread to parts of South Darfur and persists in North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling, which with the 19 Oct Amiet market strike keeps the Alert.
for_you: Sudan's war continues to kill civilians and drive hunger. FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. Aid agencies warn that famine risk is spreading in Darfur and Kordofan.
rubric_hit: Famine spreading to new areas (South Darfur, FEWS NET) and continued mass-casualty strikes on civilians
